purpose: Prepare one bounded readiness-only receiver runtime on the existing supported macOS 13.7.4 ARM64 target using the exact loader-verified c2ace candidate. This document creates no credential, guest root, process, listener or event.

scope.runtime: readiness-only; no producer invocation, receiver envelope, Hub forwarding, HA observation or data-bearing action
scope.edge_action_now: none; wait for a separate fresh runtime handoff and authorization
scope.fresh_root_status: Hub retained the root after one bounded startup failure; Edge did not create it and no new input may be added without fresh authorization

candidate.build: Go 1.27.0 darwin/arm64; CGO_ENABLED=0; GOARM64=v8.0; trimpath; no VCS metadata; stripped

receiver.required_result: Loopback-only listener; no public or wildcard bind

receiver_status.source_behavior: The target-compatible status patch uses a loopback default for the optional status host and net.JoinHostPort formatting; the status endpoint must remain loopback-only.

receiver_startup_bearer.source_requirement: Absolute clean path; regular file owned by the service euid; mode has no group/other bits; 1..4096 printable ASCII bytes
receiver_startup_bearer.current_status: Missing in the bounded startup attempt; not created or read by Edge
receiver_startup_bearer.boundary: Required by the pinned receiver startup producer even when no record is submitted; it is an environment binding, not a receiver JSON field

hub.status: not started or bound by this proposal
hub.reason: Receiver-only readiness does not authorize a shared Hub fixture or forwarding event

receiver_config.source_rule: Use only the pinned receiver template fields above; the required bearer is a separate environment binding and no dispatcher or Edge process is part of this receiver-only readiness gate.

receiver_server_identity.certificate_requirements: Fresh receiver server leaf, IP SAN 127.0.0.1, key correspondence verified without exposing the key

client_auth_trust.certificate_requirements: Fresh owner-only client issuing CA; any later synthetic client leaf must be separately sealed and verified as CA:FALSE with critical digitalSignature/keyEncipherment and TLS Web Client Authentication

startup_bearer.status: Fresh Hub-owned value required under later authorization; no value is recorded here

identity_proposal.identity_boundary: This proposal records receiver paths and verification rules only. No certificate, private key, bearer value, synthetic identity or credential was created, read or copied.

root.status: Retained by Hub after one bounded startup failure; do not add or replace inputs without fresh authorization

directories.purpose: Fresh receiver server certificate/key and client-auth CA
Separate required receiver startup bearer input; no Edge process is part of this gate

files.source: Fresh Hub-owned receiver server certificate; not issued by this proposal
Fresh Hub-owned receiver server private key; not issued by this proposal
Fresh Hub-owned client issuing CA; not issued by this proposal
Fresh Hub-owned startup bearer; required by receiver initialization but not created or recorded by this proposal

fresh_root_layout.no_other_files: Do not add retained state, old identity versions, stale credentials, producer artifacts or unlisted config fields to this root.

template.validation: The proposed receiver document uses exactly these top-level and tls field names; the bearer is required only through TESLATLAS_FLEET_TELEMETRY_BEARER_FILE and no dispatcher pseudo-field is in JSON.

status_patch_sources.behavior: Loopback status binding and configured-host formatting tests passed; the earlier wildcard status listener regression was fixed.

focused_tests: Go 1.27.0 with CGO_ENABLED=0: go test -count=1 -mod=readonly ./datastore/teslatlas passed
Go 1.27.0 with CGO_ENABLED=0: go test -count=1 -v -mod=readonly ./server/monitoring passed both status tests
source_validation.candidate_validation: Hub independently verified the exact candidate on host and macOS 13.7.4 guest: SHA, size, arm64 Mach-O, macOS 13.0 minimum, system-only dependencies, valid ad-hoc signature and -help exit 0.

readiness_gate.current_boundary: Do not start the guest or any runtime from this proposal.
future_order: Hub obtains a fresh explicit runtime authorization, verifies the retained R1 root is the exact owner/mode-correct root from the bounded attempt, and verifies the proposed bearer path is absent before creating only that file.
Hub verifies macOS 13.7.4 build 22H420, arm64, admin uid 501 and the exact c2ace candidate bytes before staging.

Hub stages only the fresh receiver config, fresh receiver TLS inputs and the required fresh 0600 bearer file bound through TESLATLAS_FLEET_TELEMETRY_BEARER_FILE; every path, owner and mode is recorded without printing values.
If separately authorized, start only the receiver, then verify its loopback listener at 127.0.0.1:21444 and /status at 127.0.0.1:21445.
Do not invoke the synthetic producer, submit an envelope, poll or mutate Hub/HA, or advance any ACK/frontier in this readiness-only gate.
readiness_gate.failure_rule: Any occupied or ambiguous bind, stale input, wrong candidate identity, non-loopback listener, missing required input or non-200 readiness response aborts before a data-bearing action.

cleanup_contract.owner: Hub for guest, fresh root and shared runtime; Edge records only its redacted receipt
cleanup_contract.current_action: None; the guest is stopped and the root is retained from the bounded startup failure; Edge is not changing it.
future_order: Do not invoke or retry a producer event; this gate has none.
Stop the receiver first within the bounded 10-second supervisor margin; record exit result and PID/UID.
Verify 127.0.0.1:21445 and 127.0.0.1:21444 are closed and no unrelated listener or process was touched.
Retain the versioned fresh root and redacted receipts for audit; do not delete, overwrite, down -v, reuse or merge it with any prior root.
Hub stops the existing macos13-arm64 guest only under its own bounded lifecycle authority; Edge does not start or stop it in this proposal.
cleanup_contract.receipt_requirements: Record exact process/listener closure, root mode/ownership, candidate identity and no-secret/no-payload log scan without recording private values.

ownership_and_safety.edge: Owns source validation, candidate binding, receiver field contract and this proposal.
ownership_and_safety.hub: Owns any fresh target availability, root creation, credentials, TLS inputs, process launch and cleanup.
ownership_and_safety.coordinator: Owns any separate data-bearing submit-once authorization.
